settings.title: Settings
settings.language.title: App language
settings.language.detail: The language TensorAgent's own screens are shown in. The model replies in whatever language you write to it.
settings.sandbox.runCode.title: Run code
settings.sandbox.runCode.detail.ios: Let the model run shell commands and scripts. Everything runs inside the app, confined to this chat's own folder; it can never write elsewhere on the device.
settings.sandbox.runCode.detail.mac: Let the model run shell commands, Python and Node as programs on this Mac. The macOS sandbox confines each one: it cannot read your home folder, and it can write only to this chat's own folder and the system's temporary folders.
settings.sandbox.runCode.detail.windows: Let the model run shell commands, Python and Node as programs on this PC. Windows cannot confine them, so they run only while "{setting}" is on as well.
settings.sandbox.unconfined.title: Run without a sandbox
settings.sandbox.unconfined.detail: Windows cannot confine what a program reads, writes or connects to, so code the model runs could reach anything your account can. Off by default, and while it is off the model is not offered the shell. Turn it on only if you accept that.
settings.sandbox.network.title: Allow network access
settings.sandbox.network.detail: Let code the model runs reach the internet, and let it install packages. Off by default: with it off, every attempt is refused and the model is told why.
settings.sandbox.subAgents.title: Sub-agents
settings.sandbox.subAgents.detail: Let the model hand self-contained parts of a request to helper agents that run on the same model and report back. Each helper is a separate conversation held in memory, and while this is on every prompt also declares the tools for it.
settings.sandbox.note: Changes here take effect straight away: the sandbox on the next command the model runs, sub-agents on the next message.
settings.generation.replyLimit.title: Reply output limit
settings.generation.replyLimit.detail: Maximum NEW tokens requested for one reply — this is not the context-window setting. {context} A reply uses only what remains after the prompt.
settings.generation.context.reduced: The model supports {modelTokens} input + output tokens; TensorAgent currently keeps {activeTokens} active to fit this device.
settings.generation.context.configured: The model declares {modelTokens} input + output tokens; the configured active window is {activeTokens} tokens.
settings.generation.context.model: The loaded model's input + output context window is {modelTokens} tokens.
settings.generation.context.active: The active input + output context window is {activeTokens} tokens.
settings.generation.context.unknown: The loaded model determines the input + output context window.
settings.generation.kvCache.title: KV cache precision
settings.generation.kvCache.detail: How the conversation's key/value cache is stored. On a phone this is often the larger half of what a loaded model costs, so Q4 buys back more memory than any other choice here.
settings.generation.kvCache.note: KV cache precision applies the next time a model is loaded — the cache is allocated when the model is. Some models ignore it and always use FP16, because their attention cannot read a quantized cache; the engine substitutes rather than failing.
settings.generation.toolTimeout.title: Tool timeout
settings.generation.toolTimeout.detail: Seconds before a command is stopped.
settings.generation.reasoning.title: Show reasoning by default
settings.generation.reasoning.detail: Start each chat with the model's thinking visible.
settings.generation.speculative.title: Speculative decoding
settings.generation.speculative.detail: Guess a few tokens ahead and check them in one pass: the same answer, faster on code and on replies that quote a file. The engine switches it off by itself while it is not paying, and some models cannot do it at all. Applies from the next reply.
settings.downloads.cellular.title: Download over cellular
settings.downloads.cellular.detail: Model files are several gigabytes. Off by default so a download waits for Wi-Fi.
settings.downloads.optional.title: Include optional files
settings.downloads.optional.detail: The image projector and the speculative-decoding draft head. Larger downloads, but without the projector a model cannot see pictures.
settings.downloads.note: A download keeps going while you use the rest of the app, and for a while after you leave it. If the system stops it, it resumes from where it got to the next time TensorAgent is open — nothing is fetched twice.
settings.alert.deleteAll.title: Delete all chats
